principle: Authority is explicit and flows downward. Implementation cannot silently redefine product truth.

levels.rule: Highest authority for locked product behaviour and current production truth.
Permanent fact/fiction, evidence, locality and publishing boundaries.
Edition-specific factual, narrative, locality and evidence truth.
A human may approve or reject candidates and may explicitly revise higher locks. Silence is not approval.
Defines execution powers, write scopes, handoffs and escalation.
Replaceable execution detail. Never grants product authority.

immutable_boundaries: Facts can change the fiction. Fiction must never quietly become fact.
Evidence establishes the world. Fiction determines what happens within it.
Connection may be shown. Causation requires evidence.
A worker cannot approve its own publication-critical output.
Fictional people or generated scenes cannot be presented as documentary evidence.
